title: Princess Leia
subtitle: House Organa
description: A young, precocious royal, Princess Leia Organa was not above playing pranks on her mother in order to frolic in the woods outside the palace. This particular ruse led to trouble when she found herself kidnapped by outlaws working for the Inquisitorius in a bid to lure Obi-Wan Kenobi from hiding. Young Leia spoke her mind and has no trouble bossing around even a wizened old Jedi.
